integrity: The open primary PDF was inspected at the QHRD density, CDF, survival, hazard, admissibility condition, qualitative shape statement, and rendered Figure 3. A closely related 2025 QHRD inference article was inspected at its model definition and hazard-shape claim. The correction is an exact parameter-space classification and the standalone checker was replayed from its packaged path.
scientific_limitations: The result corrects the global hazard-shape classification and the Figure 3 decreasing example; it does not reassess the full estimation procedure.
Admissible negative-beta cases with positive lambda can have an initially decreasing segment before turning upward.
A recent unindexed correction may exist.
title: The admissible QHRD has no globally decreasing hazard branch
